title: BetaClaudeTagSlackChannelIdentifiers
description: The identifiers Slack shows for a channel. They are Slack's own, not identifiers of this API.

workspace_id.description: Slack's identifier for the workspace the channel is in, starting with `T`, such as `T0123ABCD`.

channel_id.description: Slack's identifier for the channel, starting with `C` or `G`, such as `C0456EFGH`.
